title: 19-BCV-011 - Polyethylene film for greenhouse enclosures

facts.text: The variance allows polyethylene film that does not meet CAN/ULC-S109 to enclose qualifying commercial greenhouses.

Conditions include plant-growing use only, no public access, and flame-spread rating not exceeding 25; greenhouses used for other purposes, including customer sales areas, remain subject to CAN/ULC-S109.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
